goal: P4: friction Stop-gate trigger (d), wiki/diagrams layer with Archify evidence pins + diagram_check.sh, promotion ladder + auto-memory docs, Mermaid out, deferred notes; ship 0.8.0
verify: bash scripts/validate.sh green incl. §12 friction + §13 diagram check; wiki/diagrams/system.architecture.json validates 9/9 with --repo-root .; grep -ri mermaid templates/ skills/ reference/ empty; both manifests 0.8.0

decisions.what: Friction pass = one fixed-string grep over the transcript (interrupt marker + is_error) under LC_ALL=C, counts over the candidates; a denial is an is_error result and is subtracted from errors.
decisions.why: BSD grep in a UTF-8 locale cost +153 ms on 5 MB with three -E pipelines; fixed strings + C locale brought it to +≈90 ms. The ≤50 ms aspiration in the spec is not met and is recorded as such.

decisions.what: diagram_check.sh diffs since the diagram's pinned revision (when it is an ancestor of HEAD), falling back to the merge-base window.
decisions.why: A diagram authored on a branch after the changes it depicts was flagged by its own branch under the merge-base window — a false positive on the very first dogfood run.
decisions.evidence: bash scripts/diagram_check.sh main is silent on this branch after authoring wiki/diagrams/system

decisions.what: The SAR/PROJECT_PATTERN replacement lines say 'text-diagram DSLs that cannot be verified against the code' instead of naming Mermaid.
decisions.why: The spec's verify is a literal grep for the word across templates/ skills/ reference/; naming the thing we removed would keep the grep non-empty forever.
decisions.evidence: grep -rin mermaid templates/ skills/ reference/ → empty

decisions.what: Version bump committed before the diagram, and the diagram pinned to that commit.
decisions.why: skills/using-strata/SKILL.md is a pinned source; bumping it after pinning would have made the first diagram_check report the diagram stale on its own branch.

gotchas: bash 3.2 (macOS /bin/bash) mis-parses a quote character inside "${var:-default}" — keep defaults with apostrophes in their own assignment
BSD `seq 1 0` counts DOWN and emits two lines — generate fixture loops with bash arithmetic, not seq
In this shell `grep` is rewritten to ugrep by the RTK hook, so shell-measured timings do not match what a script sees (BSD grep); measure inside the script
Archify `labelAt` is a point [x, y], not a fraction along the edge
Archify showcase fails composition/desktop-readability when viewBox width × node copy projects below 6 px at a 1440 px viewport — shrink the viewBox before shrinking text
A tracked .strata/state file modified by add-debt blocks `git checkout` in a fixture — commit state before switching branches in tests
